mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 4.6% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting investor concerns about labor market weakening and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing the threshold or Rank IC > 0.05 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in economic demand (GDPC1) and decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a dual signal of robust growth and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive correlation between the proxy interaction and 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates compress discount rates, reducing the present value of future equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative in tightening periods or Rank IC > 0.05 over any 6-month period.

mechanism_narrative: An upward movement in the INDPRO supply index reduces inflation expectations, lowering equity risk premiums and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) without a corresponding increase in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 50k in 3 months AND UNRATE falls < 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both economic demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) creates a dual signal of robust growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive correlation between the proxy interaction and 60-day returns (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession labor market recovery, rising unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with improving employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market normalization, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp AND PAYEMS rises > 50k in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 12-month period.
